simple.summary: תִּבְנִי (Tibnîy) means Tibni , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 16 21.

definitions.full: H8402. Tibni תִּבְנִי proper name, masculine rival of Omri (We Israel u. Jüd. Geschichte., 3rd ed., 70 , compare Sidon. Thabnit ); — 1Kin 16:21-22 , (twice in verse); Θαμνει , ᵐ5 L Θαβεννει . תַּבְנִית see בנה . תַּבְעֵרָה see בער .
